problem: All 15 node categories have ZERO cross-category semantic edges (link, paper-section-of, cross-paper-tag, cross-paper-dependency). Only 3 same-category link edges exist out of 964 total. Categories are entirely siloed.
impact: Tag-based routing cannot discover cross-domain connections. A node in 'benchmark' cannot reach a node in 'config' or 'script' via semantic paths. Graph navigation requires jumping through shared-tag co-occurrence only.
solution: Add explicit cross-category link edges based on content relationships. The auto-tagging of 170 previously-untagged nodes will naturally create shared-tag edges across categories on next graph rebuild. Additionally, the following explicit link edges should be added in the NexusGraph database.
